parsed.explanation: Strong, recent trans-specific legal and institutional protections—constitutional gender-identity equality, hate-crime/service protections, protected bathroom access, independent equality/recourse—point to low visitor exposure. No trans criminalisation or organised targeting; survey victimisation is regionally low, though harassment/online hostility exists and reporting is incomplete. Negative but limited traveler-facing evidence: a pending border case involving detention/removal of an LGBTI asylum seeker and documented past prison male-section abuse with court damages; current corrections practice still lags, leaving custody/emergency-care outcomes partly unresolved. Rule of law is broadly protective rather than hostile, and subnational risk appears isolated rather than systematic. Weighting severity over probability of outing, these open questions and localized institutional failures slightly temper an otherwise high score.
